title: Torra Doza
description: Captain Imanuel Doza was the station operator on the Colossus. His daughter, Torra Doza, was one of the station's Ace Pilots. In that respect, she took after her mother, Resistance pilot Venisa Doza. Torra became a key part of the Resistance herself, training hard to take on the First Order's TIE fighters. Torra formed a strong friendship with Kazuda Xiono, who understood the risks that Torra's mother took.
